dialect: SQLite (the only grammar sqlite3-parser implements; default features YYNOERRORRECOVERY and NDEBUG)
parser_family: SQLite grammar: lemon-rs port of SQLite's parse.y (LALR tables generated by the crate's bundled rlemon at build time) with a hand-written Rust tokenizer; libsql-sqlite3-parser, turso_sqlite3_parser, limbo_sqlite3_parser and oxisqlite-sqlite3-parser are forks of the same code
api: sqlite3_parser::lexer::sql::Parser::new(&Bump, local bytes) and FallibleIterator::next -> Option<Cmd>; the harness reads Stmt::Select (Select, OneSelect::Select, FromClause, JoinedSelectTable) and Stmt::Insert (QualifiedName, DistinctNames, InsertBody, OneSelect::Values) and walks Expr for FunctionCall/FunctionCallStar names and Literal values
coverage: Rust LLVM source coverage in the sqlite3-parser crate (tokenizer, parser driver and AST) plus the parse.rs Lemon parser that its build script generates into OUT_DIR (reported separately), with libFuzzer sanitizer counters
scope: One SQL statement from local bytes with the SQLite grammar; valid SELECT-with-join and multi-row INSERT controls only, each matching the hand-written oracle summary. The AST keeps string literals as quoted tokens; the adapter strips the outer quotes. Other SQLite syntax and the optional extra_checks feature are untested.
